history.summary: Freehold 452 sqft 1BR in D14 Aljunied/Geylang at $779k / $1,723 psf, marketed on 'high rental yield' — a shoebox yield play with no built_year, no URA data, and a losing arena record (Elo 1098, 116-147). Low quantum is the draw; appreciation prospects are weak.
history.rating_rationale: The $779k quantum and freehold tenure make this an accessible yield asset 580m from Aljunied MRT, but 452 sqft 1BR is the thinnest resale segment, there's no built_year and no URA match (so appreciation is unverifiable), and the arena Elo of 1098 with a 116-147 losing record signals weak head-to-head standing. $1,723 psf is full for a Geylang-fringe shoebox. Buy it for cashflow, not growth — Neutral.
